verification_instructions: Build or release evidence must be produced from a protected main branch commit or a protected release tag.
Remote CI provenance must identify a successful GitHub Actions CI run for the tested commit.
release:supply-chain-artifact-evidence must generate SHA256SUMS for generated release evidence and detected release artifacts.
release:integrity-verify must verify every SHA256SUMS entry against the repository-local files before release evidence is accepted.

owner-governance evidence must record branch_protection, required_status_checks, protected_tag_policy, remote_ci_workflow_provenance, and signature_or_integrity_authority as satisfied before this mechanism can support a Release Ready claim.
scope: Brownie repository-local release integrity authority until a stronger artifact signing mechanism is introduced.
non_goals: This decision is not an OSS license or publish posture decision.
This decision does not replace independent human reviews.
This decision does not claim Release Ready while cross-platform artifacts, smoke tests, or other release blockers remain open.
